description: ONE VALUATION OF A GROWING CROP, ON ONE DATE, ON ONE BASIS. The history rather than the current figure: IAS 41 remeasures a biological asset at each reporting date, and the SEQUENCE of those remeasurements is what an auditor tests — a single current_value with no trail behind it is an assertion nobody can check. Each row records what the value was, how it was arrived at, and who says so.

fields.description: Which basis THIS valuation used. On the row rather than only on the asset, because a change of basis is itself an accounting event — IAS 41.30 presumes fair value and permits cost only while fair value is not reliably measurable, so the date an operation moved from one to the other is a disclosure.
fields.label: Method

fields.description: HOW THIS NUMBER WAS REACHED — 'orchard appraisal, Smith & Co, 12 Mar', 'accumulated establishment cost per the cost centre'. THE MOST IMPORTANT COLUMN ON THE ROW. A fair value with no stated basis is somebody's opinion formatted as a figure, and it is the first thing an auditor asks about.
fields.label: Basis
